CustomField.description: Automatically calculates the last day of insurance policy coverage from the start date and contract term. This is the final covered day, not the day after: a 1/1/2025 start with a 12-month term ends 12/31/2025. Blank when the term is blank or zero (e.g. Life policies with no fixed end).
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK( Insurance_Start_Date__c )), Insurance_Term_months__c > 0 ), ADDMONTHS(Insurance_Start_Date__c, Insurance_Term_months__c) - 1, NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Derived from the Insurance Start Date and Contract Term (Months). This is the final day the policy remains valid — a policy starting 1/1/2025 with a 12-month term ends 12/31/2025. Blank if no term is entered.
CustomField.label: Insurance End Date
